name: LiverMetSurvey Oncologic Outcomes Reference Values
description: A collection of reference oncologic outcome values derived from the LiverMetSurvey intended to benchmark and compare alternative treatment results for colorectal liver metastases.
evaluation_method: statistical_metrics (overall survival, disease-free survival, hazard ratios, perioperative outcomes)
reputation: Derived from the LiverMetSurvey registry and used as a reference in hepatobiliary oncology research; respected within surgical oncology communities.
notes: Aggregated clinical registry reference (non-LLM benchmark). Potential selection and center heterogeneity biases; subgroup sizes may be small; not intended for direct patient-level prediction without proper clinical validation and governance.
